title: Identify the top 5 districts (by name) with the highest average salary, amo
question: Identify the top 5 districts (by name) with the highest average salary, among those that satisfy all of the following: (1) have at least one account with weekly statement issuance ('POPLATEK TYDNE'), (2) that account has an associated loan of less than 200,000 USD, and (3) the district recorded more than 4,000 crimes in 1995. For each such district, also report the total number of female clients residing there.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.XCL_017
    FROM district d
    INNER JOIN account a ON d.XCL_017 = a.XCL_002
    INNER JOIN loan l ON a.XCL_001 = l.XCL_034
    WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
      AND l.XCL_036 < 200000
      AND d.XCL_031 > 4000
),
female_counts AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_012 AS district_id, COUNT(c.XCL_009) AS female_count
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_012
)
SELECT d.XCL_018 AS district_name,
       d.XCL_026 AS average_salary,
       COALESCE(fc.female_count, 0) AS female_client_count
FROM district d
INNER JOIN eligible_districts ed ON d.XCL_017 = ed.XCL_017
LEFT JOIN female_counts fc ON d.XCL_017 = fc.district_id
ORDER BY d.XCL_026 DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.XCL_017
    FROM district d
    INNER JOIN account a ON d.XCL_017 = a.XCL_002
    INNER JOIN loan l ON a.XCL_001 = l.XCL_034
    WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
      AND l.XCL_036 < 200000
      AND d.XCL_031 > 4000
),
female_counts AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_012 AS district_id, COUNT(c.XCL_009) AS female_count
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_012
)
SELECT d.XCL_018 AS district_name,
       d.XCL_026 AS average_salary,
       COALESCE(fc.female_count, 0) AS female_client_count
FROM district d
INNER JOIN eligible_districts ed ON d.XCL_017 = ed.XCL_017
LEFT JOIN female_counts fc ON d.XCL_017 = fc.district_id
ORDER BY d.XCL_026 DESC
LIMIT 5

    d.XCL_018 AS district_name,
    d.XCL_027 AS average_salary,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.XCL_010 = 'F' THEN c.XCL_009 END) AS female_client_count
FROM district d
INNER JOIN (

    FROM account a
    INNER JOIN loan l ON a.XCL_001 = l.XCL_034

WHERE d.XCL_031 > 4000
GROUP BY d.XCL_017, d.XCL_018, d.XCL_027
ORDER BY d.XCL_027 DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.XCL_017
    FROM district d
    INNER JOIN account a ON d.XCL_017 = a.XCL_002
    INNER JOIN loan l ON a.XCL_001 = l.XCL_034
    WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
      AND l.XCL_036 < 200000
      AND d.XCL_031 > 4000
),
female_counts AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_012 AS district_id, COUNT(c.XCL_009) AS female_count
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_012
)
SELECT d.XCL_018 AS district_name,
       d.XCL_026 AS average_salary,
       COALESCE(fc.female_count, 0) AS female_client_count
FROM district d
INNER JOIN eligible_districts ed ON d.XCL_017 = ed.XCL_017
LEFT JOIN female_counts fc ON d.XCL_017 = fc.district_id
ORDER BY d.XCL_026 DESC
LIMIT 5
